_readme: Edit host, port, database and user. Do NOT put the password here: it is asked every time the server starts. Keys starting with _ are notes and are ignored.

ssl._modes: disable | prefer (try SSL, fall back to plain; same as pgAdmin 'prefer') | require (encrypted, certificate not checked) | verify-ca (certificate checked, host name not) | verify-full (certificate and host name checked; recommended)

_ticketCreators: Help desk ticket creators: eobc:<id from resolver_login_eobc> or hd:<resolver_id from resolver_login_hd>. Only these accounts see Type, Source and Date received.
_wingTables: Which resolver table holds the assignees of each routing 'wing'. eobc matches adminusername, hd matches user_name.

auth._passwordHash: auto | md5 | sha1 | sha256 | sha512 | bcrypt. Find out with: npm run db:check -- --hash-test
auth._sampleOtp: SAMPLE ONLY: every dealer OTP is this value and nothing is emailed. Replace with a real OTP/SMS service before any real use.

uploads._dir: Folder on this machine where attachments are saved (the full path is stored in the database). Example: "/Users/you/Documents/Helpdesk/uploads" or "C:/Helpdesk/uploads".
